references.text: Direct continuation of the same event: Joseph brings his sons forward to their father Jacob.
Describes the physical position of the sons in the same event that begins in verse 1.
Climax of the same event: Joseph's attempt to correct his father's hand during the blessing.
Theological completion: From the visit of the sons (chapter 48) to the sight of the third generation (chapter 50).
Thematic contrast: Jacob's fear of losing his children (42) versus joy over his grandchildren (48).
